tei:div.tei:p: thugs rje chen po'i bsgom bzlas ni/ skyabs sems tshad med bzhi bsgom zhing*/ stong pa'i ngang las padma zla ba'i steng*// rang nyid thugs rje chen po ston zla'i mdangs// zhal gcig phyag gnyis shel phreng pad dkar bsnams// dar dang rin chen rgyan rdzogs skyil krung bzhugs// thugs kar zla steng hrīḥmathar yig drug 'khor// bzlas pas 'gro kun rgyud sbyang snang grags kun// rang byung thugs rje chen po'i rol pa'o// yig drug bzlas shing snying rje 'bungs// za chog tshogs kyi 'khor lor shes// bsod nams stobs rgyal zhus pa'i ngor// ngag dbang dpal bzang bris pa dge ༈ lha gcig rgyal ba kun 'dus spyan ras gzigs// sngags gcig snying po kun 'dus yi ge drug /chos gcig bskyed rdzogs kun 'dus byang chub sems// gcig shes kun grol ngang nas yig drug sgrongs// āoṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ hrīḥ bod gangs ri'i mgon po spyan ras gzigs// mgon spyan ras gzigs la gsol ba 'debs// spyir 'gro ba yongs la thugs rjes gzigs// dus snyigs ma'i sems can khyed kyis skyobs// āoṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ hrīḥ lha snying rje'i dbang phyug spyan ras gzigs// mtshan thos pas ngan 'gro'i 'jigs pa skyob// spyir 'gro ba yongs la thugs rjes gzigs// dus snyigs ma'i sems can khyed kyis skyob// āoṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ hrīḥ chos rig sngags rgyal mo za ma tog /sras rgyal ba ma lus bskyed pa'i yum// spyir 'gro ba yongs la thugs rjes gzigs// dus snyigs ma'i sems can khyed kyis skyob// āoṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ hrīḥ
